settings.label: Type
settings.notice: What the section shows. Changing it shows the content fields that type reads.

settings.label: Position
settings.notice: Order on the app Home, smallest first. The seeded sections use steps of 10 so a new one fits in between.

settings.label: Audience
settings.notice: Targeting only: signed-in customers and guests can each get their own Home.

settings.label: Store View
settings.notice: All Store Views shows the section in English and Arabic, with the matching title.

settings.label: Show From
settings.notice: Store time. Empty: from now on.

settings.label: Show Until
settings.notice: Store time. Empty: no end. The app also hides the section by itself once this passes.

settings.label: Title (English)
settings.notice: Empty: the default title of the type, if it has one. A single "-" hides the section header.

settings.label: Title (Arabic)
settings.notice: Shown on the Arabic store view. Empty: the Arabic default title of the type.

settings.label: Category
settings.notice: Category rail: its products (children included). Popular products: optional, limits the rail to it. Bundle deals: optional, only bundles under this top-level category.

settings.label: Sellers
settings.notice: Featured stores: these approved sellers, in this order unless a sort is chosen. Top vendors: optional, limits the ranking to them.

settings.label: Product SKUs
settings.notice: One SKU per line, in the order to show. Products the storefront would not show (disabled, unapproved, inactive seller) are skipped.

settings.label: CMS Block
settings.notice: Default: hm_delivery_promise, hm_home_promos or hm_home_trust for the matching type. The store view's own copy of the block is used; a disabled block hides the section.

settings.label: Items
settings.notice: Most items to show, 1 to 50. Hero banners: most carousel slides.

settings.label: View All Link
settings.notice: Store path (clothes.html, bundles, sellerlist, shop/loly, brand) or a full https:// address. The app opens categories, products, stores, brands, bundles, deals and searches natively.

settings.label: Side Tiles
settings.notice: How many side tiles follow the slides (0 to 6). Empty: 3, as on the website.

settings.label: Chip Order
settings.notice: Category URL keys, one per line: the chips shown, in this order. Empty: the top-level menu categories in catalogue order.

settings.label: Chip Icons
settings.notice: One per line: url_key=glyph, e.g. clothes=👗

settings.label: Chip Tints
settings.notice: One per line: url_key=slot, slot 0 to 7 (0 mint, 1 blue, 2 amber, 3 pink, 4 lavender, 5 cream, 6 rose, 7 indigo).
